expectations.evidence: The opening line names the posture 'registration-led candidate, sponsor-led as the default it would overturn.' The section 'What settles it for us' says that employer-bought training tickets are 'exactly the case the skill names for promoting registration-led above the sponsor-led default.' It splits the condition into two parts: (1) the audience attends on employer training budgets, marked ✅ as stated by the user, and (2) the program already clears those budgets, marked ❓ unconfirmed. It explains why the promotion matters, since revenue scales with what the audience pays and the sponsor pool
